cards.text: War is coming. The Philistines camp in Judah, and Saul, king of Israel, lines up his army in the Valley of Elah. Philistines on one hill, Israel on the other, and a whole valley in between.
Then a champion walks out of the Philistine camp: Goliath, from Gath, six cubits and a span tall. Friend, I stand on a gold base and I'd STILL need a ladder just to say hello.

cards.question: Goliath's helmet, his coat of mail, the armor on his legs and the javelin slung between his shoulders. What are they all made of?

cards.text: His spear shaft is like a weaver's beam, and his shield bearer walks out in front of him. This man's SHIELD has its own assistant.

cards.question: Goliath shouts across the valley to the ranks of Israel. What does he want them to do?

answers.text: Choose one man to come fight him
Send their whole army down at once
Give up and go back home

cards.question: Goliath says if Israel's man wins and kills him, the Philistines will become Israel's servants.

cards.text: No small talk, friend. He just yells it: "I defy the ranks of Israel this day! Give me a man to fight!"

cards.question: Saul and all the Israelites hear Goliath's challenge. How do they take it?

answers.text: They're angry and ready to charge
They're calm and start making plans

cards.text: Now over to Bethlehem. Jesse, an old man there, has eight sons, and one of them is named David. The three oldest, Eliab, Abinadab and Shammah, followed Saul into battle.

cards.question: And David? He's Jesse's ___ son.

cards.text: David goes back and forth from Saul to tend his father's sheep in Bethlehem. Meanwhile, Goliath keeps stepping out every morning and every evening, like an alarm clock nobody can find the off button for.

cards.question: How many days does Goliath keep coming out to take his stand?

cards.text: One day Jesse hands David roasted grain and ten loaves of bread for his brothers, plus ten portions of cheese for their commander. Then he tells him to hurry to the camp.

cards.question: Jesse gives David one more job when he gets to his brothers. What is it?

answers.text: Check on them and bring back word
Tell them to stand up to Goliath

cards.text: David gets up early, leaves the flock with a keeper and heads out. He rolls into camp just as the army marches out shouting the battle cry, and the two sides line up face to face.

cards.question: David leaves his supplies with the quartermaster and runs to the battle line.

cards.text: When he gets there, he asks his brothers how they're doing. While they're talking, here comes Goliath, shouting his usual words, and this time David hears them too.

cards.question: The men of Israel see Goliath coming. What do they do?

answers.text: They flee from him in great fear
They charge down the hill at him
They stand still and hold the line

cards.text: Turns out the soldiers have been talking. The king has a reward for whoever kills Goliath.

cards.question: What does the king promise the man who kills Goliath?

answers.text: Great riches and his daughter in marriage
Half his kingdom and a palace
A seat at the head of his army

cards.question: The reward also says the winner's father's house won't have to pay taxes in Israel.

cards.text: I'd hop down that hill for TAX-FREE alone, friend, gold base and all. And David asks the men around him, "What will be done for the man who kills this Philistine and removes this disgrace from Israel?"

cards.question: Then David asks a second question: just who is this uncircumcised Philistine? Who does David say Goliath is defying?

answers.text: The armies of the living God

cards.text: The men tell David about the offer. And his oldest brother, Eliab, hears him talking with the men.

cards.question: How does Eliab react when he hears David talking to the men?

answers.text: He's proud of his little brother
He takes David to see Saul

cards.text: Eliab asks who's watching those few sheep and accuses David of pride, saying he only came to see the battle. David's answer is pure little brother: "What have I done now?"

cards.question: After Eliab's scolding, David drops the subject and stops asking about the offer.

cards.text: Somebody overhears what David's been saying and reports it to Saul. And Saul sends for him.

cards.question: David stands before Saul and says no man's heart should fail because of this Philistine. What does David offer?

answers.text: To go and fight Goliath himself
To go home and bring more men
To play the harp for the troops

cards.question: Saul hears David's offer to fight Goliath. What's his answer?

answers.text: You're just a boy and he's a warrior
Take my whole army with you
Wait for your brothers to decide

cards.text: David tells Saul that whenever a lion or a bear carried off a lamb, he went after it, struck it down and rescued the lamb from its mouth. Friend, my oven timer beeps and I jump so high my gold base comes with me.

cards.question: David tells Saul he has killed lions and bears. What does he say this Philistine will be like?
David tells Saul the ___ who delivered him from the lion and the bear will deliver him from this Philistine.

cards.text: Saul tells him to go, and may the LORD be with him. Then Saul dresses David in his own tunic, a bronze helmet and armor.

cards.question: David straps his sword over the tunic and tries to walk. How does that go?

answers.text: He can't walk in it all and takes it off
It fits like it was made just for him
He keeps it all on and heads right out

cards.text: No armor this time. David goes down to the brook, picks out five smooth stones and drops them in the pouch of his shepherd's bag.

cards.question: Stones in the bag, David heads toward Goliath. What's in his hands?

cards.text: Goliath comes closer and closer, his shield-bearer still walking out front. Then he gets a good look at David.

cards.question: Goliath looks David over and despises him. Why?

cards.text: Goliath asks if he's a dog, that David comes at him with sticks, and he curses David by his gods. Big talk, friend, from a man whose shield needs an assistant.

cards.question: Goliath threatens to give David's flesh to the birds of the air and the beasts of the field.

cards.text: David answers him, "You come against me with sword and spear and javelin, but I come against you in the name of the LORD of Hosts, the God of the armies of Israel, whom you have defied."

cards.question: David says this day the LORD will deliver Goliath into his hand. Then what will the whole world know?

answers.text: That there is a God in Israel
That David is a mighty warrior
That Saul is a great king

cards.question: David tells everyone gathered there that the LORD doesn't save by sword or spear. Why not? Because the battle is the ___'s.

cards.text: David says the LORD will give them all into Israel's hands, and Goliath starts forward to attack. Everybody else ran AWAY from this man, friend, and David RUNS straight at him.

cards.question: David reaches into his bag, takes out a stone and slings it. Where does it hit Goliath?

cards.text: The stone sinks into his forehead, and the champion falls facedown on the ground. Six cubits and a span, flat on his face. ONE stone.

cards.question: When David brings Goliath down, he has a sword in his hand.

cards.text: David runs over, pulls Goliath's own sword from its sheath, kills him and cuts off his head.

cards.question: The Philistines see that their hero is dead. What do they do?
The men of Israel and Judah charge forward with a shout. How far do they chase the Philistines?

answers.text: To Gath and the gates of Ekron
To the banks of the Jordan

cards.text: On the way back, Israel plunders the Philistine camps. David takes Goliath's head to Jerusalem and puts Goliath's weapons in his own tent.
Now back up a moment. As Saul watched David go out to face Goliath, he asked Abner, commander of the army, whose son this young man is, and Abner said he didn't know.

cards.question: Abner doesn't know who David's father is. What does Saul tell him?

answers.text: Find out whose son he is
Give him a sword and shield
Send him home to his family

cards.text: So when David comes back, still holding Goliath's head in his hand, Abner brings him straight to Saul.

cards.question: Saul asks, "Whose son are you, young man?" What does David answer?

answers.text: The son of your servant Jesse of Bethlehem
The son of your servant Eliab of Judah
The son of your servant Shammah of Socoh

cards.text: Stick around, friend, because this story is just getting warmed up, like my ovens at sunrise.
